title: Skills Overview
summary: Every skill, how XP and levels work, level rewards, milestone coins and talents.

s.x: Skills are how your character grows. You gain XP in a skill by doing what it is about (mining, chopping, fighting...), and each level gives permanent stats, a talent point and new things to craft and buy. There are seven skills, each capped at level 50. Open the SkyRPG menu with K for the Skills page, or type

All seven skills use the same curve. The table shows the XP needed to reach each level in total.

Reaching level 10 takes 1,000 more XP than level 9. From level 21 each level grows by only about 2.7%, so the last step (49 to 50) takes 21,500. At a typical pace (about 2,500 XP an hour) one skill reaches level 20 in about 20 hours, 30 in 65, 40 in 125 and 50 in about 200 hours, before any Insight, minions or events. Level 50 is the cap, and the action bar shows "MAX" once you get there.

Every 5th level pays coins equal to the level times 100: 500 coins at level 5, 1,000 at level 10, up to 5,000 at level 50. That is 27,500 coins per skill over its ten milestones.

for that skill, so a maxed skill has 50 points. Spend them in the SkyRPG menu (K, Talents) on that skill's perks. Most talents have several ranks and cost one point per rank, and the stronger ones unlock at a skill level. Talents give stats and the same gear effects as items do, so they stack with gear. You can have a talent point left over, and there is no deadline to spend it.
A reset gives all of a skill's points back. It is free once a day, then costs 2,000 coins.

Put your first points in the talents with no level requirement (the +Fortune and +Speed ones), then pick up the rare-find and double-drop talents as they unlock. The big ones appear at levels 20 to 30.

Combat XP comes from kills, and tougher mobs pay more: 6 for a zombie, skeleton or husk, 5 for a spider, 8 for a creeper, 10 for a witch or blaze, 12 for an enderman, 15 for a wither skeleton or ghast, 40 for a ravager, 100 for an Elder Guardian, 500 for a Warden, 1,000 for the Wither and 2,000 for the Ender Dragon.
